data.body_html:
A Marbella fishing and sunset combo charter is the best way to pack two Mediterranean experiences into one day. You spend the morning or early afternoon chasing dentex and amberjack off the Costa del Sol, then return to sea as the sun drops behind La Concha. The transition from angler to sunset-chaser happens without changing boats — just a change of pace, a cold drink, and a different kind of catch.

This guide covers everything you need to plan your own day-to-dusk adventure from Puerto Banús: which boats work best, what the itinerary looks like, what you'll catch, and how to book. If you're ready to go, check our fleet and message us on WhatsApp.

Why combine fishing and sunset on the same charter?

Most charters force you to choose: a fishing trip that ends at 2pm, or a sunset cruise that starts at 6pm. A combo gives you both without paying for two separate bookings. You get the thrill of a strike mid-morning, then the calm of a glassy sea at dusk — all from the same deck. The Marbella coastline works in your favour here: fishing grounds are just 2–3 nautical miles offshore, and sunset viewpoints like Cabopino and Cala del Faro are a short cruise from the fishing zones.

Which boats are available for the combo?

The combo works best on our Tier A boats, which offer the best value for a full-day charter. Both depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks.

  • Astondoa 40 — 12.5 metres, 9 passengers, €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours
  • Azimut 39 — 12.5 metres, 11 passengers, same pricing

For larger groups (up to 12 pax), you can upgrade to the Azimut 58 Flybridge or Mangusta 80 — pricing on request via WhatsApp. The Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) is another solid option for smaller parties who prefer a sportier ride.

Sample itinerary: 8-hour day-to-dusk charter

This is the most popular schedule, using the 8-hour rate (€2,299) on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39.

TimeActivity
10:00Depart Puerto Banús, head west toward Cabopino
10:30–13:30Fishing at grounds off Cala Cortés and Río Verde
13:30–14:00Return to Puerto Banús for lunch break (ashore)
14:00–18:00Free time — explore Marbella, rest, or grab a bite
18:00Re-board at Puerto Banús for sunset cruise
18:00–20:00Cruise east past Marbella Marina, Golden Mile, and La Concha
20:00Return to Puerto Banús as the sun sets

If you prefer a continuous 6-hour charter without the break, we can adjust the timing — just let us know when booking.

What fish can you expect?

Marbella's inshore waters hold a mix of species year-round. In spring and autumn, dentex and sea bream are common near rocky bottoms off Cabopino. Summer brings amberjack, bluefish, and occasional small tuna. Mackerel and horse mackerel are almost always present. Our skipper knows the marks and will move if the action is slow. Catch-and-release is standard, but you can keep a few for a beach barbecue if you arrange it separately.

What's included in the price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and Spanish IVA (21%). Onboard you'll find soft drinks, water, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. Fishing rods, reels, bait, and basic tackle are provided. The sunset leg doesn't include a separate meal, but you're welcome to bring your own food.

Best sunset viewpoints from the water

The sunset cruise takes you past Marbella's most photogenic coastline. From the sea, you'll see the Golden Mile hotels, the silhouette of La Concha mountain, and the lights of Puerto Banús coming on. Our favourite spots include:

  • Cabo de Calaburras — the westernmost point, with clear views of the horizon
  • Calo del Faro — a small cove near the lighthouse, often calm and quiet
  • Offshore from Marbella Marina — the city lights reflect on the water as the sky turns orange

The skipper can pause for photos or drop anchor for a swim if conditions allow.

How to book your Marbella fishing and sunset combo charter

Availability is limited, especially in July and August. Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and boat choice. We'll confirm pricing and send a booking link. A 50% deposit secures the date; the balance is due 7 days before departure. Last-minute bookings (within 48 hours) require full payment.

For more options, browse our full fleet or read about other Marbella boat experiences.
